en: Don't mind Skuerto, adventurer. He doesn't mean to be rude, he's just terribly busy. While we wait for him to finish scouting, why don't we work on something more productive?
Hello, adventurer. Welcome to Refuge Pointe.
What do you ask of me?

We at Refuge Pointe hold one of the few remaining patches of Stromgarde territory in the Arathi Highlands. And we're losing ground...

If you have words for me, then I hope they are good tidings.
Where would you like to fly to?
We must not allow the Alliance to expand their power base in Arathi! Even their miniscule Refuge Pointe may one day grow to threaten us.

The battle for Arathi Basin is a battle for resources. Lumber, ore, food... all these are needed in order to wage a good war.

Denying our enemies of their supplies is as good as killing them on the battlefield.
Greetings, adventurer. I am Doctor Gregory Victor, head trauma surgeon of Horde Trauma.
You have learned all that I am able to teach you at this time, Doctor adventurer. Return to me when your practice has expanded and I shall train you in the ways of the more advanced medicinal arts.

It is good to see you again, Doctor adventurer. I have been following your progress and I dare say that it is time you learned some of the more advanced bandaging techniques.

Return to me from time to time, as your skill advances, and I shall teach you all that I know.
Get the key and unlock these chains! Hitah'ya the Keeper holds it... back of cave...
The League of Arathor has sworn to retake Arathi for humans of Stromgarde and the Alliance. It is a battle hard fought, but a battle worth fighting.

I am Rutherford Twing, the main supplier for the Defilers posted here at Arathi Basin. As you improve your standing with us, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you might find useful. Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

I am Samuel Hawke, the main supplier for the League of Arathor posted here at Arathi Basin. As you improve your standing with us, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you might find useful. Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.
To win this war, we can't sit idle and let the tides sweep us over. We must strike, hard and fast, or Arathi will never again be ours.
These shards glint with an unnatural sheen. It is clear that they hide a deep power within.
Thanks to the Warchief, even here in the ruins of our former prison, some hope remains, and the Horde rises anew.
This wooden board holds roughly-made wanted posters.
